sourceClass: Pinned decompiled mirror with per-file identities; official PC V2.2 corroboration separate; not original-PC observation
method: Derived factual constants/metadata only; no third-party source bodies copied. All75 constructors asserted; all75 numeric/base/up effect mappings manually cross-reviewed. Conditions/queues/keywords rely on linked method sections and shared-system tests.

cards.review: Base/up numerical effects and special mappings reviewed in three25-card batches; initializers alone do not prove action semantics. Refer to per-card use/upgrade sections and independent execution/order tests.
